name: case-review
title: Case review brief
for_each: select id,code from applications order by code

sections.title: Application
sections.note: Internal review copy. Records a human process; never authorises a benefit or payment.

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: select name,policy_reference,due_on,reference,finding,checked_by,expires_on from v_evidence where application_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Recent activity
sections.sql: select actor,action,note,created_at from activity where application_id=$1 order by sequence desc limit 20

name: decision-record
title: Decision record
for_each: select id,code from applications order by code

sections.title: Application
sections.note: Internal review copy. Records a human process; never authorises a benefit or payment.

sections.title: Recorded human decisions
sections.sql: select revision,outcome,reason,policy_reference,evidence_reference,reviewer,created_at from decisions where application_id=$1 order by revision desc

sections.title: Recent activity
sections.sql: select actor,action,note,created_at from activity where application_id=$1 order by sequence desc limit 20

name: appeal-review

sections.title: Appeal history
